laya-mcp: could not find a Python interpreter with the `laya-mcp` package installed.
  Tried: python3, python
  Install it with:  pip install "laya-mcp[mcp]"
  Then retry. Python 3.10+ is required.
  Already installed it? Point this launcher at the interpreter directly:
      set LAYA_MCP_PYTHON=C:\path\to\python.exe     (Windows)
      export LAYA_MCP_PYTHON=/path/to/python        (macOS, Linux)
  (LAYACORE_PYTHON is still read, for anyone who set it back when
  earlier versions named that one here.)
  Activating the virtualenv you installed into also works.
  Note that Laya is a PyTorch model, so the first install downloads torch (~2 GB) and the first run downloads a checkpoint (~650 MB).
